I am playing tourist in a place I have spent thirty years living in.
I went to a temple in my own city,
a place I have visited before,
perhaps passed by a thousand times without giving it much thought.
I wasn't rushing to get somewhere else.
I was there simply to be there...
To notice the colours, the details,
the little things I might otherwise walk past.
To stand still for a moment
and let the place be more than just another familiar corner of my city.
